blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Space Agency (PhilSA) on Monday warned the public about suspected rocket debris in Philippine waters near Palawan, following another rocket launch in China. According to PhilSA, China’s Long March 12 rocket was launched from the Hainan International Commercial Launch Center in Wenchang, Hainan, at around 4:24 a.m. READ: PhilSA moves closer to 2027 rocket launch after South Korea training Debris from the launch was projected to have fallen approximately 25 nautical miles from Puerto Princesa, Palawan, and 19 nautical miles from the Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park. “While not projected to fall on land features or inhabited […]...
